Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Are my PDF files saved by Tacopdf?

No. All processing (such as splitting, merging, watermarking) is done locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to our servers, ensuring 100% privacy.

Are Tacopdf tools really free?

Yes, all PDF tools we provide are free to use. We use non-intrusive ads to support the operational costs of this website.
